review_notes: I read the whole file. It has one new definition, `clipPositive M a := min (max a 0) M`, plus theorems. I searched Mathlib for a matching clamp or clip concept and found none. `Set.projIcc` and `LipschitzWith.projIcc` return the subtype `Icc a b`, not a real number, so they are a different representation and not a drop-in replacement. `clipPositive` is also not a generic wrapper over an existing Mathlib definition. In the same project, `clipUnit` (in `WeightedCutoff.lean`) is the `M = 1` case of `clipPositive`, and `radialCutoff` in `HeatFisher.lean` is built on `clipUnit`. That overlap is internal to the project, not with Mathlib, Batteries or core, so I did not count it under this rubric. The other declarations are theorems, which the rubric excludes. The structures they use (`IsSlopeMajorant`, `IsRelaxedSlope`, `lpMultiplier`, `lpAbs`, `boundedMultiplier`) are defined in other project files, not here. I did not check those other files against Mathlib. Remaining uncertainty is limited to those files.
